tooltipForm.releaseTitle: Do not include version information like Remix or Uncut in the main Title field. Use the Version field instead.
tooltipForm.version: A particular iteration of the product that will be delivered to stores and displayed alongside the title. Example: 'Live' , 'Deluxe Version'. If multiple versions of an album exist, use this field to indicate the correct version.
tooltipForm.releaseType: Indicates the size of the release package (i.e. Single, EP, Album).
tooltipForm.label: This field determines the label under which your release will be created.
tooltipForm.eanUpcCode: The Universal Product Code (UPC), is a 12 or 13 character long numeric code typically used to identify one or more master recordings in certain media type.
tooltipForm.catalogId: Unique code used to identify the label's product. This field is optional and serves as an identifier on your label's side, used, for example, in month-end reports.
tooltipForm.primaryGenre: A conventional category that groups together pieces of music sharing a set of conventions or traditions. This will determine where a product will chart and how it will be sorted with similar music.
tooltipForm.subGenre: A more niche category that helps differentiate a piece of music according to its region, style, or sound, carrying its own set of characteristics that clearly distinguish and set it apart within the larger genre.
tooltipForm.metadataLanguage: The language of the product's metadata.
tooltipForm.variousArtistsCompilation: If this release contains 5 or more artists, select this box to designate it as Various Artists.
tooltipForm.cLineYear: The first year this version was released anywhere in the world.
tooltipForm.cLineOwner: C Line owner identifies the entity which legally owns the copyrights to the release's associated creations such as cover art, liner notes and metadata.
tooltipForm.pLineYear: The year the sound recording was first released anywhere in the world.
tooltipForm.pLineOwner: P Line owner identifies the individual/entity which legally owns the sound recording.
tooltipForm.languageTrack: The main language of the song in this release. For example: Vietnamese, English, etc.
tooltipForm.countryLanguage: The official language of the country related to this release. For example: Vietnam, United States, etc.
tooltipForm.isMoreThan4Artists: Select 'Yes' if this release has 5 or more artists to display as 'Various artists'.
